summary: Tested BAKĒD Super App Phase B (Expo Web export at /api/app-preview/, 390x844) end-to-end plus the new backend notification endpoints. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests pass (OTP request/verify, wrong-code rejection, notifications list/read-all/read-one, 401 gating, wallet, /auth/me, MART/FOOD/SHOP/SEND category APIs, app-preview mount, website smoke). Frontend: every flow in the review list passes. Covered: splash, onboarding in FR/EN (language persists), Skip, location skip/manual/current (geolocation denied shows location-message), Google Places 'Cocody' (5 results), welcome as guest, persistence on reload (address/context/onboarding), 6 module cards in order, AUTO alert with no navigation, MART/FOOD/SHOP/SEND homes with their own API categories, switcher (ACTIF badge, AUTO/IMMO aria-disabled, close/backdrop), context-aware Home tab, logo back to main home, Explore (lait→mart group, send_parcel intent, filters, empty state, hit→MART), guest gating, OTP login (+225, dev code, wrong-code error), redirect preservation (header-wallet→login→wallet-screen), logged-in wallet chip 0 CFA, notifications empty, activity empty with filters, rewards, session persistence, logout. Found and fixed 1 UI bug: the +225 country prefix was hidden on the login screen on web.

minor.issue: Strips the leading 0 from CI numbers: 0700000001 becomes +225700000001 (9 digits). Since 2021, Côte d'Ivoire numbers are 10 digits including the leading 0 (+2250700000001), as the function's own docstring says. Real SMS delivery to CI numbers would fail or go to the wrong number. The website flow shares this code.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent. The TextInput (flex:1) kept the web <input>'s intrinsic min-width, so the row overflowed (scrollWidth 418 > 342). autoFocus then scrolled the overflow:hidden row 78px and hid the '🇨🇮 +225' prefix (only '5' showed). Added minWidth:0 to the input style and rebuilt with npm run export:web. Verified: scrollLeft 0, prefix fully visible.

issues: The browser's default white focus outline draws a rectangle inside the rounded search field. Add outlineStyle:'none' (web) to those TextInputs.
The 'Poulet' cuisine tile renders an empty image (broken or missing image_url).
Categories show only letter placeholders (M, B, S...). No images, so it looks unfinished next to MART/FOOD/SEND.
Seed data: 'Lait de Coco' shows an eggplant image and 'Lait Bébé 1er Âge' has no image.
Shows 'Choisir une adresse' with the subtitle 'Livraison à', which reads oddly when nothing is chosen.

action_items: Decide on the CI phone normalisation in core/utils/phone.py (lstrip('0') drops the significant leading 0 of 10-digit CI numbers). Fix it carefully because the website and existing customers share it.
Optional: add an SPA fallback for /api/app-preview/* so that refreshing on a sub-route serves index.html instead of a 404 {detail: Not Found}.
Remove the web focus outline on the search TextInputs; fix the FOOD 'Poulet' image; add SHOP category images.
The notifications screen never calls POST /customers/me/notifications/{id}/read (items aren't tappable). Wire it up when notifications become actionable.
critical_code_review_comments: SessionContext: if /auth/me fails offline, the token is kept but customer stays null, so the user looks like a guest until the next launch. Consider caching the customer profile.
Static mount (StaticFiles html=True) has no deep-link fallback, so reloads on sub-routes 404.
Onboarding Skip is hidden on the last slide (fine by design). The last-slide CTA correctly reads 'Commencer'.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (after 1 minor UI fix)

seed_data_creation: Test customers created via OTP: +225700000001, +2250700000002-style random numbers from pytest.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The app is at /api/app-preview/ (static Expo export from /app/mobile/dist). Each browser_automation run is a fresh context, so onboard every time: onboarding-skip → location-skip → welcome-guest. Don't page.reload() on sub-routes (404); use goto(root). The AUTO module card fires window.alert, so register a dialog handler. Disabled switcher cards are outside the viewport, so use dispatch_event('click'). The OTP dev code appears in otp-dev-code. Rebuild after source edits: cd /app/mobile && npm run export:web.
rca of the issue: Login prefix hidden: on RN-web a TextInput renders <input>, which has an intrinsic min-width. With flex:1 and no minWidth:0 it overflowed the overflow:hidden row, and autoFocus's scroll-into-view shifted the row left by 78px. Mitigation: minWidth:0 on the input.
